GTA VI sur PC : ce que Rockstar a annonc: GTA VI on PC: what Rockstar has announced
Three points, and not one more.
GTA VI est annoncé sur PlayStation 5 et: GTA VI is announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.
Rockstar n’a rien publié sur une version: Rockstar has published nothing about a PC version: no announcement, no release window, no page on Steam or the Epic Games Store, no system requirements.
Rockstar présente le jeu comme une expér: Rockstar presents the game as a single-player experience on the two consoles.
La version PC, si elle arrive, sera anno: The PC version, if it comes, will be announced by Rockstar: not by a store, not by a rumor.

Trois jeux, trois écarts très différents: Three games, three very different gaps: one year, a year and a half, fourteen years.
La seule chose qu’ils ont en commun : à: The one thing they have in common: each time, the PC version was announced by Rockstar on its Newswire a few weeks before its release, and GTA V’s PC date was pushed back twice before it arrived.
Toute « version PC » ou « bêta » de GTA: Any GTA VI “PC version” or “beta” offered today is a scam
Il n’existe ni version PC, ni bêta, ni a: There is no PC version, no beta and no early access.
What you’re being offered isn’t the game.
Pas de version PC, pas de bêta, pas de c: No PC version, no beta, no key: anything presented that way before a Rockstar announcement is fake.
Un fichier à télécharger, une « clé bêta: A file to download, a “beta key” to win, “early access” in exchange for a payment or a sign-up: these are the usual forms fake versions take, and they come back before every big game.
Le but est de voler un compte, un paieme: The goal is to steal an account or a payment, or to install malware.
GTA VI ne s’achète que sur le PlayStatio: GTA VI can only be bought on the PlayStation Store, the Microsoft Store, the Rockstar Store and from retailers selling the box (a code, not a disc).
Rockstar n’a ouvert aucune bêta ni aucun: Rockstar has opened no beta and no public test: nobody can invite you to one.
Acheter une « clé » ou un compte à un ve: Buying a “key” or an account from a third-party seller goes against Rockstar’s policy, which says so on its account security page.
Aucun site, aucune vidéo, aucun message: No site, no video, no message can give you the game “early”; in August 2026, fake “Extended Look” and “demo” sites were spreading a program that steals passwords.
Rockstar le rappelle pour son compte : n: Rockstar says the same about its accounts: don’t download anything from a third-party site, and watch out for emails that imitate its own.
Si tu as entré un identifiant ou un paie: If you entered a login or a payment on one of those pages, change your password and tell your bank.
